biggest_catch: Rewards are per survey in points with frequent screen-outs — no guaranteed surveys, and the effective hourly rate is low; also, PayPal cashout requires reaching Silver membership level, so your first cashouts may be limited to gift cards.
catches: Per-survey point values vary by survey; the 100 points = $1 conversion is documented by third-party assessments of the platform's official redemption terms, not in a public official rate table.
PayPal cashout (500 points / $5) requires Silver membership level; first PayPal/Bitcoin/bank withdrawals take ~24 hours for manual account verification.
Gift cards start at 200 points ($2); PayPal and crypto (BitPay) start at 500 points ($5).
Rewards process in hours for Silver+ members but can take ~24 hours for Bronze members; random account security checks can add delays.
Points are forfeited if the account is closed or banned for terms violations.

c3.evidence: Free to join and earn; no fee to participate or redeem on any official page.

c4.evidence: Official prizerebel.com blog article retrieved (minimum-withdrawal and redemption-process statements quoted above).

eligibility: Free account required; PrizeRebel's official public pages checked do not publish a minimum-age figure (third parties report 13+ with parental consent in the US). PayPal cashout requires Silver membership level and a PayPal email matching the PrizeRebel account.
notes: The 100 points = $1 conversion and the 500-point PayPal / 200-point gift-card figures are consistently documented by third-party assessments of the platform's official redemption terms; the company-published concrete fact is the $5 minimum withdrawal. payout_quote: Because PrizeRebel has a really low minimum withdrawal amount of only $5, you can redeem prizes every single day and be sure that you don't have to wait until you've racked up tons of points before you can turn them into prizes.

s1.note: Account required; PayPal path requires Silver level and matching PayPal email — gift cards available from 200 points regardless.

s2.note: No fees; first PayPal/Bitcoin/bank withdrawal held ~24h for manual verification; rewards cannot be canceled once processed.

s3.note: Silver+ members: usually a few hours; Bronze: ~24 hours; first PayPal/Bitcoin/bank withdrawal: 24-hour manual check (official blog).

s4.note: No weasel words on the $5 minimum — stated flatly on the official blog.

s6.note: Steps concrete: free join, earn points via surveys/offers, redeem at 500 points ($5) PayPal or 200 points ($2) gift cards.

steps: Create a free PrizeRebel account and verify your email.
Earn points by completing surveys and offer-wall tasks (each shows its point value upfront).
Reach the redemption threshold: 500 points ($5) for PayPal cash or crypto via BitPay, or 200 points ($2) for select gift cards.
For PayPal: make sure the email on your PrizeRebel account matches your PayPal email and that you have reached Silver membership level.
Request the reward; allow a few hours (Silver+) to ~24 hours (Bronze / first PayPal withdrawal) for processing.
timing: Silver+ members: a few hours; Bronze: ~24 hours; first PayPal/Bitcoin/bank withdrawal: 24-hour manual verification.
